definition_boundary.lean_established: Pivotal trace cyclicity follows from the right-dual mate identities and naturality of the pivotal isomorphism; the Kirby cut trace is constructed from this theorem.
definition_boundary.not_established: Equality of left and right traces from EGNO Theorem 4.7.15; that stronger statement is not needed for cut movement.

established: Steps 1 through 4 remain established: objectwise canonical pivotal formula, natural isomorphism, monoidality, and ribbon-to-canonical-spherical construction.
For any pivotal right-rigid monoidal category and composable coupons f : X -> Y and g : Y -> X, the pivotal traces of f followed by g and g followed by f are Lean-proved equal.
The proof moves f across the cup as f*, across the cap as f**, and then uses naturality of the pivotal isomorphism.
The cyclicity proof does not assume sphericality, semisimplicity, finitely many simples, or a concrete category.
Every SphericalStructure now determines SphericalTraceLaws without a caller-supplied cyclicity equality.
Every RibbonStructure now determines the canonical SphericalCutTrace consumed by the Kirby presentation-isotopy layer.
Fifteen mutation tests reject all Step 1-5 convention errors, objectwise non-natural pivotal maps, wrong dualized cyclic order, and missing cut cyclicity.
Thirty-seven Step 1-5 and downstream constructor declarations pass the kernel axiom audit without sorryAx or a native proof oracle.
The full 1600-job umbrella build and all ten Step 4-5 artifact replay tests pass.
explicit_nonclaims: This objective note is not yet a theorem claim about a complete four-manifold invariant.
EGNO Theorem 4.7.15, equality of left and right traces in a spherical tensor category, has not been formalized because it is not needed for pivotal trace cyclicity.
The finite semisimple fusion-category interface remains open.
The trace-pairing and coupon compatibility layer remains open.
No independent braiding-free construction of the duality-induced double-dual tensorator has been compared with the equation-(8.31)-characterized tensorator in Lean.
No concrete fusion, premodular, or modular category has been instantiated by this step.
No Kirby-colour expansion, category-bound Kirby move, or complete four-manifold invariant is established by this step.
